# go.lint runs golangci-lint with the project's config: an issue fails the
# target, only the changed package is linted again, and fixing it passes.
[!exec:go] skip
[!exec:golangci-lint] skip

bit
stdout 'lint ▶ golangci-lint run \./\.\.\.'
stdout 'lint ✔ ok'

bit
stdout 'lint · no changes'

cp bad.go.new a/bad.go
! bit
stdout 'lint ▶ golangci-lint run (\./)?a \(''a/bad\.go'' \(new\) changed\)'
stdout '1 of 2 packages affected'
stdout 'a/bad\.go:3:6: func unusedThing is unused \(unused\)'
stdout 'lint ✘'
stderr 'test target ''lint'' failed'

rm a/bad.go
bit
stdout 'lint ✔ ok'

# The config is an input.
cp golangci.yml.strict .golangci.yml
bit
stdout 'lint ▶ golangci-lint run \./\.\.\. \(''\.golangci\.yml'' changed\)'

# Narrowed runs work when bit starts through a symlinked directory, whose
# path the go command keeps from PWD.
exec ln -s sym link
exec sh -c 'cd link && exec '$BIT
cp bad.go.new sym/a/bad.go
! exec sh -c 'cd link && exec '$BIT
stdout 'lint ▶ golangci-lint run (\./)?a '
stdout 'test ▶ go test -json \./a '
stdout 'a/bad\.go:3:6: func unusedThing is unused \(unused\)'
! stdout 'outside main module'
stdout 'test ✔'

-- BUILD.bit --
lint = go.lint {}
-- .golangci.yml --
version: "2"
linters:
  default: none
  enable:
    - unused
-- golangci.yml.strict --
version: "2"
linters:
  default: none
  enable:
    - unused
    - ineffassign
-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- a/a.go --
package a

func A() int { return 1 }
-- b/b.go --
package b
-- sym/BUILD.bit --
lint = go.lint {}
test = go.test { package = "./..." }
-- sym/.golangci.yml --
version: "2"
linters:
  default: none
  enable:
    - unused
-- sym/go.mod --
module example.com/s

go 1.22
-- sym/a/a.go --
package a

func A() int { return 1 }
-- sym/a/a_test.go --
package a

import "testing"

func TestA(t *testing.T) {
	if A() != 1 {
		t.Fatal("A")
	}
}
-- sym/b/b.go --
package b
-- bad.go.new --
package a

func unusedThing() {}
